title: Bundle the `ia-approval` and `ia-repo` public base kits
summary: Carries `inventarch/ia-approval-kit` 0.1.0 (`approval-system`: `@approver`, `@approval-rule`, `@docket` and `@approval` with the offline Ed25519 + RFC 8785 JCS `check-seal` verifier) and `inventarch/ia-repo-kit` 0.1.0 (`repo-system`: `@repository`, `@layer`, `@package` and `@area` with the rank-independent dependency-role grammar and offline `check-layers` verifier) under Apache-2.0 alongside the three lane defaults.
